title: 第23章 修仙界第24章 法术修炼
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
宋文拿起那一叠黄符，好奇的查看起来。
他发现这些黄符只有十二张是画好的，其他全是空白符纸。画好的符纸也并不都是完全一样的，经宋文判定，这些符纸一共有四种。
宋文还发现，符纸的纸张并不是普通的宣纸，而是由某种动物毛皮制成，异常的柔软。
其上的墨水也不是普通墨水，而是特殊制成的，宋文还能在符纸上看到淡淡的猩红色。
宋文心神一动，拿起了一根毛笔。
“这笔应该就是专门用来绘制符篆所用。”
他又拿起一个墨盒，里面的墨水呈现猩红色，且极为粘稠，这就是画符用的墨水了。
宋文对黄符的兴趣极大，花费颇长时间来研究，他脑中还清晰记得极阴使用黄符，召唤出火球时的恐怖威慑力。
现在这些黄符都是他的了，只是他现在还不明白这些黄符要怎么使用。
宋文将目光看向了旁边的书籍，他相信多半能从书籍中得到自己想要的答案。
第一本书是功法《长生功》，这里有从练气一层到练气九层的炼气期完整功法。
第二本和第三本是宋文曾经看过的，《低阶灵草种植详解》和极阴自己书写的灵草种植经验。
这三本书都不是宋文现在想要看的，他简单翻阅了一下后，便放下来。
《初阶符篆绘制大全》！
宋文又拿起一本新书时，不由精神一震，这是他现在最希望看到的。
宋文看完了这本书，他才知道，原来这些黄符名为符篆，全是一阶符篆。
也知道了符篆的使用方法，方法很简单，只要灌入灵力便可以激发。
他手中现有的十二符篆中，有六张是火球符，三张狂风符，两张护盾符，还有一张飞行符。
前三者全是一阶下品符篆，而飞行符是一阶中品符篆。
这张飞行符比之其他符篆明显更为老旧，

飞行符能让人御风飞行，不过只能离地三十丈，能在空中飞行一刻钟的时间，算不得真正的御空而行。
不过饶是如此，也让宋文极为兴奋。
飞天是所有人类的梦想，又有谁不曾幻想过像小鸟一样在天空翱翔，自由自在。
《初阶符篆绘制大全》一共记录的一阶共24种符篆的绘制办法，以及符纸和墨水的制作办法。
符纸和墨水的制造都极为复杂，就拿宋文手中的一阶下品符纸来说，乃是用动物的毛皮，经过泡水、脱脂、鞣制、染色、晾干等十几道工序。
而一阶中品的符纸，则不能用普通的动物毛皮来制了，必须采用妖兽的皮毛，普通动物毛皮已经不能承受其所蕴含的强大灵力。
余下的两本书没有名字，宋文通过翻看其内容得知，这两本书分别是极阴和一个名叫黄裳的人写的修行日志。
看完这两本书，宋文对修行和修仙界有了大致了解。
比如修仙者的境界划分为，练气、筑基、金丹、元婴...
content_en:
Song Wen picked up the stack of yellow talismans and examined them curiously.
He found that only twelve of these yellow talismans were drawn, and the others were all blank talisman papers. Not all the drawn talisman papers are exactly the same. According to Song Wen's judgment, there are four types of these talisman papers.
Song Wen also discovered that the paper of the talisman paper was not ordinary rice paper, but made of some kind of animal fur, which was unusually soft.
The ink on it is not ordinary ink, but specially made. Song Wen can also see a faint scarlet color on the talisman paper.
Song Wen's mind moved and he picked up a writing brush.
"This piece should be specially used for drawing talismans and seals."
He picked up another ink cartridge. The ink inside was scarlet and extremely viscous. This was the ink used to draw symbols.
Song Wen was very interested in the yellow talisman and spent a long time studying it. He still clearly remembered the terrifying and intimidating power of Ji Yin when he used the yellow talisman to summon fireballs.
Now these yellow talismans are his, but he still doesn't understand how to use these yellow talismans.
Song Wen looked at the books next to him. He believed that he could probably get the answer he wanted from the books.
The first book is the exercises "Longevity Gong", which contains the complete exercises for the Qi training period from the first level to the ninth level.
The second and third books were ones that Song Wen had read before, "Detailed Explanation of Low-Level Spiritual Grass Planting" and Jiyin's own spiritual grass planting experience.
None of these three books was what Song Wen wanted to read now. After briefly flipping through them, he put them down.
"Elementary Talisman and Seal Drawing Complete Collection"!
When Song Wen picked up a new book, he couldn't help but feel shocked. This was what he wanted to see most now.
After Song Wen finished reading this book, he realized that these yellow talismans were originally called talisman seals, and they were all first-level talisman seal scripts.
I also know how to use the Talisman Seal. The method is very simple. You only need to pour spiritual power into it to activate it.
Among the twelve seal talismans in his hand, six are fireball talismans, three wind talismans, two shield talismans, and one flying talisman.
The first three are all first-order low-grade talisman seals, while the flying talisman is a first-order mid-grade talisman seal script.
This flying talisman is obviously older than other talismans.
The flying talisman allows people to fly in the wind, but it can only be 30 feet above the ground. It can fly in the air for a quarter of an hour, which is not truly flying in the air.
However, this made Song Wen extremely excited.
Flying is the dream of all human beings, and who has not imagined soaring freely in the sky like a bird?
"Elementary Talisman Drawing Encyclopedia" records a total of 24 first-level talisman drawing methods, as well as methods for making talisman paper and ink.
The production of talisman paper and ink is extremely complicated. Take the first-grade low-grade talisman paper in Song Wen's hands as an example. It is made of animal fur and has gone through more than a dozen processes such as soaking in water, degreasing, tanning, dyeing, and drying.
The first-level mid-grade talisman paper cannot be made from ordinary animal fur. It must be made from the fur of monster beasts. Ordinary animal fur can no longer withstand the powerful spiritual power it contains.
The remaining two books had no names. Song Wen looked through their contents and learned that the two books were practice diaries written by Ji Yin and a person named Huang Shang.
After reading these two books, Song Wen had a general understanding of spiritual practice and the world of immortality.
For example, the realm of immortal cultivators is divided into Qi training, foundation building, golden elixir, Nascent Soul...
